description: Private repo with no branch ruleset (rulesets need GitHub Pro, and github_repository_ruleset only exists here if it ever goes public -- see infra/repos.tf), so no-automerge is extended last: there's no required check for platform automerge to wait on. Nothing here is deployed by CI -- pin bumps land as PRs and get rebuilt on the laptop by hand.

customManagers.description: images.json's pinned public MCP images -- registry/repo:tag pairs with no Dockerfile of their own.
backstage-mcp-server/Dockerfile's upstream pin -- upstream ships no releases, so this is a git-refs pin against main, same shape as the terraform-modules pin used fleet-wide.
